HIGH COMMAND
These commands are limited to members of the High Command, and some commands are further restricted to higher levels of command. Many of the brigade commands take the brigade "shortname" when used.
.ALLIED (TEXT): Broadcasts text to all Allied players (restricted to Div CO and above) .AXIS (TEXT): Broadcasts text to all Axis players (restricted to Div CO and above) .HOLD: Removes the infantry spawn limits on friendly depots. Also known as "Hold At All Costs" or "HAAC". .FALLBACK: Request a selected city in map to make a Fallback. City must have at least one installation captured by enemy. .HCCP: Brings up the High Command Control Panel. .OICOCVOLUNTEER (BRIGADE): Informs your High Command that you volunteer to take charge of your current brigade. .OICNOMINATE (BRIGADE) (PLAYER): Notifies your High Command that you nominate the named player to be in charge of the named brigade. .OICVETO (BRIGADE) (PLAYER): Vetoes the nomination of the named player to become OIC of the named brigade. .OICRESIGN (BRIGADE): The OIC resigns leadership of the named brigade. .OICREPLACE (BRIGADE): You replace the current OIC of the named brigade. .OICREMOVE (BRIGADE) (PLAYER): Remove the named player from the OIC position in the named brigade. .HC: Displays online HC members and OICS, as well as their brigade assignments. .HCLIST: Displays the names of all HC members online, including OIC's. .HOME: Displays your brigade home. .LISTOICS: Displays a list of current OIC assignments.
STRATEGIC
.HQOFF: Turns off "HQ" capture messages. .HQON: Turns on "HQ" capture messages. .FBS: Shows the Fire Base status for the nearest town. .FBS (TOWN): Shows the status of Fire Bases for the specified town. .OBJECTIVES I: General info about selected objective. (Also .OBJ I) .OBJECTIVES L: Lists attack and defensive objectives. (Also .OBJ L) .OBJECTIVES N: Shows number of objectives of your army. (Also .OBJ N) .OVERRUN: Alerts high command that your town of origin is overrun. .OWN: Shows owner of closest town. .OWN (CITY): Shows info about targetted town.
